blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robin Padilla said he and his allied senators are considering skipping the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte if what he described as a “distortion” of the Constitution persists. Padilla said the matter has not yet been discussed among them, but added that such a move “may happen soon.” Asked […]...
